website.data: Canyon Oak Pools | DFW Pool Builders 0 Fall and Winter are the best times to build. Call us today to ensure you’re swimming next summer! Skip to Content Home About Us Our Team Our Service Area Our Projects Pool Build FAQ Services Custom Pool & Spa Design Your Own Pool Remodel Design & Build Financing Reviews Blog Get Quote Open Menu Close Menu Home About Us Our Team Our Service Area Our Projects Pool Build FAQ Services Custom Pool & Spa Design Your Own Pool Remodel Design & Build Financing Reviews Blog Get Quote Open Menu Close Menu Home Folder: About Us Folder: Services Financing Reviews Blog Get Quote Back Our Team Our Service Area Our Projects Pool Build FAQ Back Custom Pool & Spa Design Your Own Pool Remodel Design & Build YOUR NORTH TEXAS CUSTOM POOL BUILDER Who You Build With Matters® Building pools, from our family to yours. Canyon Oak Pools is family-owned and operated by design, servicing our neighbors in North Texas. Being an elite custom builder is more than a finished product. We operate with core values of integrity, attention to detail, and unmatched customer service. Your project matters. Your home matters. Your family matters. Who you build with matters. Let us help you design the perfect pool for your space, according to your unique dreams! After our consultant walks your home and learns what is important to you, they will create an interactive 3-D design according to your exact specifications. At this stage you also get to choose materials such as tiles, water features, and stone to truly put your unique touch on your project. This entire process will be a collaboration, and you can be as hands-on as you like! Whatever your idea, let Canyon Oak Pools’ experienced team help you turn it into a reality. Pool Design Building your backyard oasis is an incredibly exciting time! Watch your dreams manifest as our experienced team takes you from “Dig Day” all the way to filling your new pool. We pride ourselves not only on decades of experience in pool construction, but also on utilizing materials that provide top-notch quality and integrity to your build. What and who you use to build your pool matters. Enjoy “white glove” customer service from start to splash. Pool Construction Transform your existing pool from an eyesore to your own peaceful paradise. Perhaps your tastes have changed, or perhaps you bought-in to a pool that never quite fit your style. Either way, a remodel is a time-efficient and cost-effective way for you to recreate the backyard you’ve always wanted! While you’re updating the aesthetics, you may also enjoy upgrading your pool operating equipment to a more energy efficient and eco - friendly system, that you control from your fingertips. You have the bones, we will make them beautiful and functional for your family! Pool Remodels Canyon Oak Pools is the company all of your neighbors are talking about! Follow along with us on a “day in the life” of your neighborhood custom pool builder! "I can’t say enough good things about Canyon Oak pools! Everything about the pool building process was enjoyable. The quality, the timeline, the communication was all top notch. They are a family run business through and through, you won’t get this level of service elsewhere. THE BEST IN THE BUSINESS!! Thank you Larry, David and Susan!!" Melissa K, Google "Canyon Oak Pools was a dream to work with from design to clean up. Every detail was explained. My questions were always answered in a very timely manner & I was never made to feel like my questions weren’t important. I wanted to beautiful pool that was great quality and that’s exactly what I received. The owner of the company himself was at our home anytime anyone was working on our pool. He expects high quality work so things were addressed before I even had to. Our pool was completed in about 53 days! I received 7 quotes from different companies but my gut told me to go with canyon oaks & I am 1000% confident I made the right choice. I have a beautiful oasis, there were no major issues or wait times & the communication was stellar. I would recommend these guys to anyone!" Megan H, Google “We are so happy with our pool! It's crazy how easy this whole process was. Mike Woodfin was extremely patient with us during the design phase, and we ended up with something that blows away anything we could have imagined. Constant communication, detailed explanations on everything as it was happening, and just great work. We can't thank Larry, Susan and Mike enough!!” Mike K, Facebook "We highly recommend Canyon Oak Pools. They communicated with us so well during the process and helped us realize the vision for our backyard oasis! You won’t regret using them." Danny E, Facebook "We’ve seen how professional and personable they are. We talked with so many companies and have built three pools at our last three homes. Canyon Oak Pools has proven to be the best group to work with. They have pictures of the prettiest pools and they’ve building a pool and outdoor kitchen at our new home in Melissa, Texas. Don’t hesitate to contact them. Larry and Susan, the owners will become your new best friends! Years of experience." Mickie M, Facebook Item 1 of 5 Get inspired by some of our latest custom pool builds! Get a Personalized Quote! Take the plunge and begin your journey to becoming a pool owner. All of our quotes are customized to your exact specifications, and are obligation-free.
